card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Parts of a number in dosing tables and instructions, such as the decimal point or a digit in 0.75, 1.75, 12.5, 36 or 46. It also fires on the space before a dose amount like 36 mg.

modes.label: Decimal point
modes.description: The point inside a decimal dose or table value, just before the last digits.

modes.label: Digit in a number
modes.description: A digit partway through a multi-digit amount, often in a table of doses.

modes.label: Space before amount
modes.description: The space just before a dose amount after reduced by or decrease by.
modes.example: reinitiate therapy at a dose reduced by<< >>36 mg.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a dose number, where the next digit or decimal part is about to appear.
